home.title: Premium access, delivered to your own Discord account.
home.lead: Pick a product, pay, and a staff member releases the key. The bot stores it, grants the matching role, DMs the key to you and takes the role back when your time runs out.

why.title: Why buying here
why.lead: The store is the front door; Discord and the bot do the delivery.

delivery.title: Keys arrive as a Discord DM
delivery.body: One action stores the key, grants the product's role and DMs the key to the buyer — nobody copies keys between chats by hand.

duration.title: Access that ends on its own
duration.body: Every product carries a duration. When it expires the bot removes the role; buying again extends the time you already have instead of replacing it.

support.title: Support in the same place
support.body: Missing roles, wrong accounts and payment questions are handled in the Discord server — the same place your purchase lives.

faq.title: Questions we get asked
faq.lead: Straight answers about payment, delivery and durations.

items.a: A staff member verifies your payment and releases the key, usually inside support hours. The key then arrives in your Discord DM and the product's role is granted at the same moment.

items.q: Do I have to be in the Discord server?
items.a: Yes. The bot can only grant a role and send a key to a member of the server, so join with the Discord account you want the access on.
Open the order after checkout. It shows the QRIS code or the bank details and a field to upload your payment proof. Staff verify from there.

Check your Discord DMs first — Discord sometimes hides messages from bots in "Message requests". Then open the order page: if the status is still waiting, upload your payment proof; if it says delivered, ping staff in the server.

items.q: Can I use the access on another account?
items.a: No. The key is bound to the Discord account that bought it — the role and the expiry timer follow that account only.

items.q: The product stopped working, or I paid by mistake.
items.a: Say so in the Discord server within your active duration. Refunds are decided by staff case by case; the store itself never moves money back on its own.

login.lead: Discord sign-in uses the identify scope only — the store never asks for your password, and never posts anything as you.

admin.title: Staff
admin.lead: Orders, promo flags and shop settings. Delivery calls the bot, so the key, role, DM and expiry all happen there.
admin.notStaff: This page is for staff accounts only. Ask an admin to add your Discord ID to STORE_ADMIN_DISCORD_IDS, or promote you from Customers.
admin.noOrders: No orders in this filter right now.
admin.resultOk: Key delivered — role granted, buyer DM'd, expiry scheduled.
admin.resultPartial: Key stored, but the bot reported a warning: {warning}
admin.botMissing: The bot is not connected (DASH_API_URL / DASH_API_TOKEN / CHRONOS_GUILD_ID). Delivery needs it.
admin.promoHint: The badge shown on the product card in the shop. It does not change the price.
admin.prodSourceNote: Products and categories live in the bot, so they show up in Discord tickets the moment you save them here.
admin.prodNoBot: The bot is not connected (DASH_API_URL / DASH_API_TOKEN / CHRONOS_GUILD_ID), so the catalog is read-only right now.
admin.prodAddHint: Only the name and the price are required. The product appears in the shop and in the Discord ticket panel immediately.
admin.prodValueHint: Used in Discord buttons — letters, numbers, dashes. Leave empty to derive it from the name.
admin.prodPriceHint: Anything the bot accepts: Rp 50.000 · 30rb · 3jt · $3 · free
admin.prodPriceUnreadable: this price cannot be read as an amount — the bot will reject it
admin.prodNoCategory: No category yet — create one first
admin.prodRoleNoBot: Role list needs the bot connection; the ID stays as it is.
admin.prodRoleHint: Granted automatically with the key, and removed when the duration below ends.
admin.prodDeleteHint: "{label}" will be removed from the bot config and from the shop. Existing keys and roles are not touched.
admin.prodLimit: The bot accepts {limit} products per server (Discord dropdown limit).
admin.prodEmpty: No products yet — add the first one above.
admin.catAddHint: Categories group products in the shop and become the buttons on the Discord ticket panel.
admin.catIdHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, dashes. Leave empty to derive it from the name.
admin.catDeleteHint: "{label}" will be removed. Products inside it move to the default category.
admin.catEmpty: No categories yet — create one above.
admin.catDefaultNote: Built-in categories (marked above) cannot be deleted; rename them instead. A category holds up to 25 products in the Discord panel.
admin.qrisHint: Public image URL (Supabase Storage or any CDN). Shown on every order that waits for payment.
admin.paymentNoteHint: Shown under the QRIS code, e.g. the account holder name.
admin.currencyHint: Only used for totals and stats — product prices keep exactly what the bot has.
admin.promoBannerHint: One line at the top of the home page. Leave empty to hide it.
admin.settingsLead: Payment details, contact links and what the shop shows. Payment itself stays manual: buyers upload a proof, staff release the key.
admin.productsNote: Products, categories, auto-roles and durations are edited in Products and stored by the bot; promo labels and the featured flag are stored here.
admin.custLead: Everyone who has signed in to the store. Promoting someone here gives them access to this whole admin area.
admin.custEmpty: Nobody has signed in yet. The first sign-in fills this list.
admin.custNoDb: Supabase is not configured, so this list is empty after every restart. Set SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.
admin.custSelf: You cannot remove your own admin role.
admin.custEnvBody: These IDs always count as admin, even if the database is empty. Remove one from STORE_ADMIN_DISCORD_IDS on Vercel to revoke it.
admin.statsBotLead: Read straight from the bot's own counters — messages, purchases, giveaways and boosters, the same numbers the Discord /stats command shows.
admin.statsNoBot: The bot is not connected, so its counters are unavailable. Set DASH_API_URL, DASH_API_TOKEN and CHRONOS_GUILD_ID to see them.
admin.statsStoreLead: From the orders in this store: how many are waiting, what was delivered, and who buys the most.
admin.statsNote: Bot counters cover everything the bot tracked per member; store numbers only count orders placed through this store. They are allowed to differ.
admin.logLead: Every write in the store: logins, orders, proofs, key releases, product and category changes, role changes and settings. Newest first.
admin.logNote: The log is stored in Supabase (table activity_log). Without Supabase it lives in memory and clears on restart.
